notes.title: Anti Cheat and Piracy (Development Update)
notes.notes:
hi everyone sorry for the long wait between updates, recently i was made aware of a site hosting my game illegally, due to this i have upped the encryption of my game files and i have also added some in game checks to make sure the copy you are playing is genuine (this is the reason EAC was added to ME_iON a bit rushed)  
due to this i have been working on overhauling the way users connect to games in ME_iON starting next update users will connect to a lobby first then the host can pick from a few parameters there will also be new teams and points system in the game YES ACTUAL TEAM DEATH MATCHES LOL there will also be user profiles with icons to pick from 
and...
COSMETICS ARE ALMOST FULLY IMPLEMENTED :D
This update is mostly UI and quality of life improvements but i have been spending most of my time under the hood programming EAC to be the best it can 

here is a new look at the main menu (Ui Subject to change)

New Lobby Map

please remember i am a one person team and updates take a while for me to implement im working as hard as i can to get these updates out ASAP <3 - Leah Lead Developer for ME_iON

notes.title: Update 0.237 News And Patch notes!!!!
notes.notes:
HELLO ALL!!!! :D im proud to announce that Update 0.237 is now Live ^-^
i have been working very hard for the past month a half to bring you guys this update i hope you enjoy what it brings to ME_iON
the full patch notes list will be at the bottom of this post but first i want to focus on some features i have added in this recent update ^-^
Map Updates
[hr][/hr]
in this update i have made a significant overhaul of the Downtown Map, i felt that down town was boring and way to open for my game so to combat this i added a construction zone in the centre of the map with lots of different elevations you can explore and attack from, i have also added a train that brings some nice background sounds 
Downtown Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260047/e9ee8106f8af415de17cb5bd3b3eb501b5bd1fd6.png
[hr][/hr]
Downtown After
[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260047/697b4ccb7bb2cf4c66f235639a2ca24a4709d731.png
currently in this update downtown is the only map that has been updated as i want to focus on one map at a time i believe this makes the outcome of my maps design higher quality as i can focus on the small details when designing 
currently this is the completion percent of each map

 downtown 90%
 backrooms 50%
 backstreets 20%
 Homeplate -% (i have stopped active development of the homeplate)

Voice Chat
voice chat is a feature i have been working on for a while now and was a goal of mine to implement before ME_iON switched to 1.0 to use voice chat in game press and hold down the V button 
A fresh New Look For The Main Menu
now that my focus of my game has shifted to stick with the low poly ascetic i realised that the main menu did not feel right in my game so i decided to swap it out with one that will fit the vibe of ME_iON much better, i also commissioned @RDhaniswara on twitter to make the beautiful buttons you will see in every menu, along with this some of you will notice the change in from from the previous version i have added a new font to all of my menus and to the banners you will now see in ur steam library and on the store
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260047/a71ced76d27bcfea9c6684fc9c2d547082bb5b14.png
the shift to Unreal Engine 5 from Unreal Engine 4
most of my time this past month and a half has been dedicated to porting ME_iON to Unreal Engine 5, this new game engine brings so much more to my game features wise and i cant wait to implement them, for those worried about performance hits to the game do not worry as i have noticed no significant impact on game performance since moving from UE4 to UE5
New Guns And Gun Models
one of the things i have put into hard consideration is the gun mechanics in ME_iON as it is the key aspect of my game, currently some of the guns may seem overpowered but dont worry as when i have more time to play test with friends i will fine tune them

notes.title: Development Update!
notes.notes:
content to come next update
Mushrooms :D
hello i am pleased to announce that ME_iON is getting a new face on the battlefield :D
next update you will have a random 50/50 channce of spawning as a mushroom (more about the mushrooms and why they are there will come soon in later dev updates ^-^)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260047/5efb805fc3fd230a278f12165b4ddd9c7794b9a4.jpg
The Shift from Unreal Engine 4 To Unreal Engine 5
also starting next update ME_iON will now run on Unreal Engine 5 for those on lower end hardware do not worry the system requirements will not change as in testing i have noticed no performance hits as of yet in testing (if this changes i will update the community with another update post with my findings)
and with a new game engine comes more opportunity's
i am currently looking into adding ray tracing as this is very easy to do in unreal engine 5 However i currently lack the hardware to test these features so i will keep ray tracing on the back burner until i get a better GPU but it is confirmed to be added to ME_iON at some point before 1.0
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42260047/23e95dae009e518183e859094e8e61f669f024ba.png
Bots Bots And More Bots!!
hopefully i should have the AI functionality flushed out in the next update and have an offline mode completed for ME_iON currently i have these little guys just look into ur sole in the game i need to add interactions with the bots and most importantly is to optimisation as unreal's default AI plugin can be very taxing on the users CPU

notes.title: ITS RELEASE DAY :D
notes.notes:
thank you!!
after months of hard work i am happy to release ME_iON in early access on Steam, i just want to thank everyone that has helped me with the development of ME_iON so far and also THANK YOU to everyone who purchases my game ^-^ this is just the beginning of an amazing game and an amazing experiences i have tones planned for this game and i hope to share more details soon with everyone so keep an eye out on the community page 
Moving Forward
moving forward after release i hope to add 3 new maps by mid July (please note this time is just an estimate) and some quality of life improvements around the same time i will also be adding to the homestead and this will be a main focus of mine after i have the new maps done, Keep an eye out for updates on the homestead on the community page 
Additional Notes
As almost all launches normally don't go according to plan please keep an eye out for bugs and report them on the community page, post launch the first week i am dedicating to fleshing out bugs that might pop up 

and now with that all out of the way i hope you enjoy my game and have fun ^-^
